observed: H100 operator vs physical vLLM: N=1 diff -0.021%, N=4 diff +0.106% (max abs 0.106%). RTX5090 matched-engine AIC vs vLLM vision tower: max diff 12.509% at N=57 (< 12.8% band), all is_valid rows.
claimed: Encoder operator matches physical measurement; matched-engine check validates against vLLM vision tower
evidence: Both halves hold qualitatively: composed operator agrees with physical vLLM encode within ~0.1%, and the matched-engine reprice against vLLM's own vision tower stays within the reported 12.8% band (max 12.509%). The intro anchor asserts no tighter tolerance, so gpt-sol's scoping nitpick is not a defect.
query: SELECT p.n_images, p.mean_ms aic, c.mean_ms vllm, 100*(c.mean_ms-p.mean_ms)/p.mean_ms pct FROM collector_encoder_fn p JOIN collector_encoder_fn c ON p.n_images=c.n_images AND p.image_px=c.image_px WHERE p.engine='aic' AND p.note ILIKE '%silicon service%' AND p.image_px=448 AND p.is_valid AND c.engine='vllm' AND c.image_px=448 AND c.is_valid ORDER BY ABS((c.mean_ms-p.mean_ms)/p.mean_ms) DESC;
